name: D_gen10_bench
description: A small benchmark collection for text generation/conditioning across ten generation scenarios designed to probe model generalization and controllability. It aggregates diverse prompt types and evaluates both automatic and human-centered outputs to assess generation quality and adherence to constraints.
general_score_metric: human_eval (complemented by automatic metrics such as BLEU/ROUGE where applicable)
reputation: Relatively low-profile community dataset with limited adoption, primarily used by its author and small research groups for generation probes.
